caption:
You're breaking under the weight. But what if it was never yours to carry? (Galatians 1:1-2 devotional)

You've been shouldering the whole outcome, sure it all falls apart the moment you let go. But your calling came “through God who raised the dead” — He begins again in the very place you'd crossed off as finished. The work was always His: He builds the church, He carries the mission, and He holds how it ends.
